output: One complete JSON object on stdout; failures use one stderr {code,message,status} and exit 1.

import.title: string
import.maxBytes: optional complete compressed/expanded store limit <=1GiB; each expanded member <=128MiB; original ZIP copy is streamed
import.expectedSha256: optional lowercase SHA256; ZIP only, verified against actual retained original.zip before native inspection and on same-ID resume

selection.array: native relative array path, root array is empty string
selection.axes: one integer index or {start,stop,step} per native axis
selection.title: string

compare.leftContentSha256: exact complete original left result content SHA256
compare.rightContentSha256: exact complete original right result content SHA256
compare.title: 1–200 characters

status.sources: all immutable inventories, including complete native nodes
status.frozen: reviewed scalar sources with relative file/SHA
status.comparisons: all immutable saved comparison metadata, counts and complete JSON/CSV/HTML file pins
status.comparisonReviews: all immutable comparison decisions against exact content SHA

frozenCommand: frozen --directory ABS --id FROZEN_SHA returns the verified original relative file plus current absolute sourceFile. Use this path for the original publisher; no absolute source path is persisted in the workspace.
lifecycle: Python mutation holds permanent operation.lock; reads are SQLite read snapshots. RUNNING/INTERRUPTED UUID is explicitly resumed with its same complete saved request. Abandon is only admitted once that native flock can be acquired; no process killing. Node must retain/drain its child promises, and show saved pending UUIDs after reopen. Init reopens only a fully valid existing original workspace; it does not overwrite invalid/partial state.

comparison.meaning: Exact original source-index tuples and typed representations only; no physical coordinate alignment, regridding, unit conversion, numerical difference or scientific equality is inferred.

metadata.id: SHA derived from operationId and contentSha256
metadata.title: string
metadata.contentSha256: SHA256 of complete original comparison JSON bytes

context.left: {source,selection,result,metadata,reviews}; full original context frozen at creation
context.right: {source,selection,result,metadata,reviews}; full original context frozen at creation

page.rows: [{ordinal,sourceIndex:[integers],status,left: original typed result row|null,right: original typed result row|null}]

comparison.reviewReceipt: {id,createdAt,comparisonId,contentSha256,decision,comment}; original COMPLETE operation envelope supplies operationId
comparison.reportHistory: Reports retain creation-time source/result review context. Later comparison-review operations remain separate immutable history in the complete workspace packet.

packet.continuity: Complete legacy inventories remain accepted. Existing completed export identities preserve their original application bytes; current exports use a new export identity.
